text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The showdown against Mr. C.B. ended in 
defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she wasn't about to back down 
like this. Sakura Chiyono O boldly 
declared that she would win next time.
And 
Mr. C.B. accepted her challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky watched
over 
the two as they enjoyed the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Maruzensky winks at her rival,
telling 
her she's someone who will become even 
more wonderful in the days ahead.
